B-10.reason: Hard problem of consciousness — no test decides subjective property

C-01.reason: P vs NP open — no general shortcut to optimal search is proven

C-22.reason: Amdahl's law — parallelization cannot exceed the serial fraction's limit

D-01.reason: FLP — no deterministic consensus in an asynchronous network with one failure

D-03.reason: CAP — cannot have all three of consistency, availability, partition tolerance

E-01.reason: Observability rank — a system may be unobservable from inside

K-01.reason: One-way functions are assumed, not proven — signatures/hashes rest on unproven hardness

K-11.reason: Trusted setup is a residual — ZKPs require a ceremony whose trust is external

M-01.reason: Gödel's first incompleteness — a formal prover cannot prove every truth of its system

M-02.reason: Gödel's second — a system cannot prove its own consistency

M-03.reason: Tarski undefinability — truth of a formal language is not definable within it

M-04.reason: Halting is undecidable — no skill may claim to always decide termination or program equivalence

M-18.reason: Kolmogorov incompressibility — no compressor can compress every input

M-20.reason: Rice's theorem — non-trivial semantic properties of programs are undecidable; a skill cannot always decide them

M-21.reason: No free lunch — a pruning heuristic cannot dominate on all problem distributions

M-24.reason: Program equivalence is undecidable — an equivalence checker is not total

P-03.reason: No-cloning — arbitrary quantum states cannot be copied

S-01.reason: Bias-variance — no single evaluation removes both bias and variance
